blocks.text: This page tracks the New Westminster MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $719,600 for a typical home, down 8.2% over twelve months.
New Westminster benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical New Westminster home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $719,600 in September 2026. That is little changed at −0.4% on the month, down 2.1% over three months, down 3.6% over six months and down 8.2% over the year. Over three years it is down 13.5%, and over five years little changed at −1.0%.
The weakest one-year move in New Westminster was for a detached home homes at −10.4%; the strongest was a townhouse at −6.8%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,356,900) and an apartment ($579,900) is $777,000, and a townhouse ($854,200) sits $274,300 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, New Westminster is 33.1% below. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 8.2% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, New Westminster ranks 20 by all-home benchmark, with Sunshine Coast above it at $805,600.

Detached homes in New Westminster: benchmark $1,356,900, down 1.5% in a month, down 4.5% in three months, down 7.7% in six months, down 10.4% in a year, down 12.1% in three years and down 2.5% in five. That is 24.0% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in New Westminster: benchmark $854,200, down 2.2% in a month, down 2.4% in three months, down 3.4% in six months, down 6.8% in a year, down 10.8% in three years and up 8.2% in five. That is 16.0% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in New Westminster: benchmark $579,900, little changed at +0.7% in a month, little changed at −1.1% in three months, down 2.0% in six months, down 7.5% in a year, down 12.6% in three years and up 2.3% in five. That is 15.0% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

blocks.text: What the New Westminster figure is
The $719,600 New Westminster figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for September 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in New Westminster?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical New Westminster home was $719,600, with detached at $1,356,900.

faq.q: Are New Westminster home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: New Westminster is down 8.2% over twelve months and down 2.1% over three months.
